label: tsubasadate1
title_zh: 常开不败(罪孽式的骄傲)

lines.en: label tsubasadate1:
I tap on Tsubasa’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Tsubasa 的名字,等她接起。

lines.en: Is it weird for me to be casually phoning the wealthiest woman in all of Kumon-mi first thing in the morning? Yes.
lines.zh: 大清早随口打电话给全 Kumon-mi 最富有的女人,怪吗?怪。

lines.en: But after many phone calls with Ayane, who I believe is in second place after the entirety of the Tsukioka family’s women, I think I’m prepared.
lines.zh: 但和 Ayane 通过那么多次电话之后——我相信她排在 Tsukioka 家全体女眷之后、位列第二——我想我已经准备好了。

lines.en: Especially after hearing how Tsubasa’s been itching to start sneaking away from her normal life again.
lines.zh: 尤其还听说 Tsubasa 正手痒着想再次从她的正常生活中溜走。

lines.en: Well, itching probably isn’t the most accurate description of her feelings- but it makes me feel a little more like she’s doing this to see me and not just to feel...un-rich for a short burst of time.
lines.zh: 嗯,「手痒」大概不是描述她心情最准的词——但这让我稍微觉得,她这么做是为了见我,而不只是为了短暂地体验一下……「脱富」的感觉。

lines.en: Oh well. I guess we’ll just have to see how things play out.
lines.zh: 唉,算了。只能走着瞧了。

lines.en: Here’s hoping that I can provide her a bit more entertainment than her husband can.
lines.zh: 希望我能比她丈夫给她多一点乐趣。

lines.en: Interpret that however you want.
lines.zh: 随你怎么解读。

lines.en: : Well, hello. I can’t say I was expecting you to call so soon after exchanging numbers.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,你好。交换号码才这么快你就打来,我可没料到。

lines.en: : Just deciding to switch things up a bit. Are you doing anything today?
lines.zh: : 只是想换换花样。你今天有事吗?

lines.en: : I’m afraid I am. Well, at least in some sense.
lines.zh: : 恐怕有。嗯,至少某种意义上。

lines.en: : I’m mostly free so long as I remain at home. But I must remain nearby in the event that I’m needed for anything involving the acquisition of another hotel for the brand.
lines.zh: : 只要待在家里,我大体是自由的。但我必须留在附近,以备品牌收购另一家酒店之类的事需要我。

lines.en: : Expanding your empire this early in the morning?
lines.zh: : 一大清早就扩张帝国?

lines.en: : Yes, well, Tsukasa was so smitten with the red-ish light district the other day that she insisted we move into that part of the city as quickly as possible.
lines.zh: : 是啊,Tsukasa 那天被那片偏红的灯区迷得神魂颠倒,坚持要我们尽快搬进城区那一带。

lines.en: : I guess I should call back some other time, then?
lines.zh: : 那我大概该改天再打?

lines.en: : I suppose. Unless you’d be willing to make the trip here, of course.
lines.zh: : 我想是吧。当然,除非你愿意跑这一趟。

lines.en: : I don’t think I own any clothes nice enough to really look the part.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我没有什么衣服体面到真能配得上那个场景。

lines.en: : Oh, I wouldn’t worry about that at all. It wouldn’t be the first time we’ve opened up parts of the manor for a tour.
lines.zh: : 哦,那个完全不必担心。向人开放公馆的部分区域参观,又不是第一次。

lines.en: : And seeing as I’m here, I could serve as your personal guide. It would be my thanks for your recent assistance in what is soon to be the next section of a corporate takeover.
lines.zh: : 而且既然我在家,我可以亲自当你的向导。就当谢谢你最近的协助——那即将成为下一场企业并购的篇章。

lines.en: Is it really okay for me to go to Touka’s house without receiving her blessing?
lines.zh: 没得到 Touka 的允许就去她家,真的没问题吗?

lines.en: Probably not. But I’m going to do it anyway because I want to make her life harder and Tsubasa and I are technically friends or something now.
lines.zh: 多半有问题。但我照样要去——因为我想让她的日子更难一点,而且严格来说,我和 Tsubasa 现在算是朋友什么的了。

lines.en: : Send me the address and I’ll head over, I guess.
lines.zh: : 把地址发我,我这就过去,我猜。

lines.en: : Splendid! I’ll have someone pick you up at the gate once you arrive.
lines.zh: : 太好了!你一到,我会安排人在大门口接你。

lines.en: : See you soon.
lines.zh: : 回头见。

lines.en: scene black
So, I guess I’m going to have to meet up with some random person first if I’m going to make my way into the Tsukioka manor.
lines.zh: 所以,想进 Tsukioka 公馆,我大概得先见某个随机安排的人。

lines.en: With my extremely limited knowledge of rich people, however, I assume that’s just par for the course.
lines.zh: 不过以我对有钱人极其有限的认识,我猜这只是常规操作。

lines.en: All I can really do at this point is hope that A) Touka doesn’t find out. And B) That Touka’s father doesn’t find out.
lines.zh: 眼下我真正能做的,只有祈祷:一,Touka 别发现。二,Touka 的父亲别发现。

lines.en: From what I understand, their relationship isn’t really as strong as it once was, but I would imagine it’s at least strong enough to not want his wife inviting other men over just yet.
lines.zh: 据我所知,他们的关系已不复当年,但我想至少还没脆弱到——愿意让妻子邀请别的男人上门。

lines.en: Yet again, though, I’m wrong just as often as I’m right.
lines.zh: 不过话又说回来,我错的频率和对我一样。

lines.en: He could very well be into that sort of thing.
lines.zh: 他也完全可能就好那一口。

lines.en: Or I could very well be walking into a death trap.
lines.zh: 或者我也完全可能正走进一个死亡陷阱。

lines.en: There’s only one way to find out.
lines.zh: 答案只有一种办法能知道。

lines.en: I receive a text from Tsubasa with her address and, after doing a quick search online to figure out exactly where she lives, I begin to make my way over.
lines.zh: 我收到 Tsubasa 发来的地址短信,上网快速查了查她到底住哪,便动身出发。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour1
Upon arriving at the Tsukioka residence, I’m escorted through several different gardens, ultimately leading to one much bigger garden where Tsubasa is hanging out.
lines.zh: 抵达 Tsukioka 宅邸后,我被引着穿过好几座不同的庭园,最终来到一座大得多的庭园——Tsubasa 正在那里消磨时光。

lines.en: She diverts her attention away from the crystal clear waters of a manmade pond I will never be able to afford and sets her sights on me- a man so clearly out of place that it must be comical to her.
lines.zh: 她把注意力从我一辈子都买不起的人工池塘清澈水面上移开,落在我身上——一个格格不入到在她眼里必定滑稽的男人。

lines.en: It was certainly comical for me the other day, so I see no reason to disbelieve things wouldn’t be the same when flipped on their head.
lines.zh: 前几天对我而言,那确实很滑稽——所以我没理由不相信,反过来也一样滑稽。

lines.en: : Welcome. I take it you found the manor okay?
lines.zh: : 欢迎。看来你顺利找到公馆了?

lines.en: : Why do you have so many gardens?
lines.zh: : 你们为什么有这么多庭园?

lines.en: scene tsubasatour2
: In case one breaks down, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是防止某一座坏掉。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour3
: I’m sorry- was that not funny? My husband always laughs at that joke.
lines.zh: : 抱歉——不好笑吗?我丈夫听这个笑话总会笑。

lines.en: : Always? Meaning you have told it more than once?
lines.zh: : 总会笑?意思是你讲过不止一次?

lines.en: : When you’re married and spend nine tenths of your life in one place, you tend to run out of material.
lines.zh: : 结了婚、又把十分之九的人生耗在一个地方,素材自然会枯竭。

lines.en: : Well, either your husband has a horrible sense of humor or he’s just trying to make you feel funny.
lines.zh: : 嗯,要么你丈夫的幽默感烂到家,要么他只是想让你觉得自己好笑。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour4
: It’s likely the former, to be quite honest.
lines.zh: : 老实说,多半是前者。

lines.en: : On a related note, does he know I’m here?
lines.zh: : 顺便一提,他知道我在这儿吗?

lines.en: scene tsubasatour5
: Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么问?

lines.en: : I’d just feel a little weird personally if my wife invited some guy to my house without telling me.
lines.zh: : 就是说,要是我老婆没跟我说一声,就请了个男人来我家,我个人会觉得有点怪。

lines.en: : You’re married? I had no idea.
lines.zh: : 你结婚了?我完全不知道。

lines.en: : What? No. That was rhetorical.
lines.zh: : 什么?不。那是反问。

lines.en: : You’re not married?
lines.zh: : 你没结婚?

lines.en: : Do I really look like the married type to you?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像已婚那型吗?

lines.en: scene tsubasatour2
: No. Which I suppose would make my darling Chika very happy for the time being.
lines.zh: : 不像。我想,这暂时会让我亲爱的 Chika 非常高兴。

lines.en: : Was that supposed to be a joke as well? Because, if so, you’re zero-for-two so far.
lines.zh: : 这也算笑话吗?如果是,你目前两投零中。

lines.en: : Less of a joke and more of a...wistful observation.
lines.zh: : 与其说是笑话,不如说是……怅然的观察。

lines.en: : And, to answer your question from earlier, my husband does not know you’re here.
lines.zh: : 还有,回答你刚才的问题:我丈夫不知道你在这儿。

lines.en: : He’s very busy and, with a house this large, I doubt we’d be able to find him even if we tried.
lines.zh: : 他非常忙。而且房子这么大,就算我们真去找,恐怕也找不到他。

lines.en: : What a wonderful problem to have.
lines.zh: : 多么美妙的烦恼。

lines.en: : Apologies again for not being able to step away, but I’m sure you’ll come to find that there’s plenty to do on these grounds. And I’m not just talking about gardening, of course.
lines.zh: : 再次抱歉我无法脱身,不过我相信你会发现,这片地里有的是可做的事。当然,我可不只是说园艺。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour1
: What I would suggest, seeing as this is your first time here and all, is a brief tour of the premises. We should be able to cover at least half of it today if we begin now.
lines.zh: : 既然你是头一回来,我的建议是先把宅子大致逛一遍。现在开始的话,今天应该能逛完至少一半。

lines.en: : I was kind of figuring this would be more of a “You and I just hang out and talk” type of thing.
lines.zh: : 我本来还以为,这更会是「你我就这么待着聊聊」的那种事。

lines.en: : Can we not do both?
lines.zh: : 我们不能两样都来吗?

lines.en: : I see this as an...introduction to my world. And if my world isn’t interesting to you, who’s to say the two of us would find any joy in talking at all?
lines.zh: : 我把这视为……我世界的导览。如果我的世界引不起你的兴趣,谁又能保证我们俩聊天会找到任何乐趣?

lines.en: : To understand each other, we must first know where the other comes from. And it would bring me a great deal of joy knowing you’d at least humor me in indulging this thought of mine.
lines.zh: : 要彼此理解,必须先知道对方从哪里来。而只要知道你至少愿意迁就我、纵容我这个念头,我就会非常高兴。

lines.en: : So instead of sneaking away today, you’re deciding to turn around and run head first into the thing you’re interested in getting away from?
lines.zh: : 所以今天你不溜了,反而调转方向,一头冲进你本来想逃离的东西里?

lines.en: : “Sneaking” is only exciting if it’s on occasion, Sensei. If I were to entirely abandon this life, it would be more akin to simply running away.
lines.zh: : 「偷溜」只有偶尔为之才刺激,Sensei。要我彻底抛下这种人生,那就更接近单纯的逃跑了。

lines.en: : Well, it doesn’t seem like I really have any say in this to begin with, so I’ll accept your tour of wealth and try my best to look impressed as you show me all of the nice things you have.
lines.zh: : 嗯,反正这件事我本来也没多少发言权,所以我接受你的财富导览,并尽力在你展示好东西时摆出一副叹为观止的表情。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour6
: Fantastic.
lines.zh: : 好极了。

lines.en: : Oh, and if we bump into Touka, just pretend you do not see her. She’d be very embarrassed knowing you’d come to visit her home without her knowledge.
lines.zh: : 哦,还有,要是撞见 Touka,就假装没看见她。她要是知道你背着她来她家做客,会非常难堪的。

lines.en: : She’s here?
lines.zh: : 她在这儿?

lines.en: : Perhaps. She does live here, after all.
lines.zh: : 也许。毕竟她就住在这里。

lines.en: : She may be getting more accommodated to life in her dorm room, but that can’t compare at all to what we’ve built over the years.
lines.zh: : 她也许正逐渐适应宿舍的生活,但那和我们这些年营造的一切相比,根本不值一提。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour1
: But I’m sure you’ll understand by the end of the tour.
lines.zh: : 但我相信,导览结束时你会明白的。

lines.en: : Now, shall we go?
lines.zh: : 那么,走吧?

lines.en: scene black
Tsubasa peels herself away from a bridge I’m sure she spends hours a week looking out over in a mix of admiration and longing.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 从一座桥边抽身离开——我确信,她每周会花好几个小时在桥上远眺,怀着欣赏与憧憬交织的心情。

lines.en: She takes a place beside me, one that I imagine was filled much more frequently by the man she fell in love with at a younger age, only to have it go vacant in years subsequent.
lines.zh: 她在了我身旁——我想,这个位置曾更常属于那个她在更年轻岁月里爱上的男人,随后多年一直空缺。

lines.en: I can not tell if she’s comfortable or not, but it wouldn’t change my position either way if she isn’t.
lines.zh: 我分辨不出她是否自在,但就算她不自在,也不会改变我的位置。

lines.en: I exist to fill the holes others can not fill on their own- whether they want them there or not.
lines.zh: 我的存在,就是为了填补别人自己填不上的洞——无论他们想不想要那些洞。

lines.en: Whether they want me there or not.
lines.zh: 无论他们想不想让我在。

lines.en: Whether I want to be there or not.
lines.zh: 无论我想不想在。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour7
: Tell me, do you notice anything different about this garden compared to the several others you’d passed on your way to me?
lines.zh: : 说说看,与我来的路上你经过的那几座相比,你注意到这座庭园有什么不同吗?

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 并没有。

lines.en: : Well, the key difference between this and the others is that this particular rock garden has been around since the Edo period.
lines.zh: : 嗯,它和其他几座的关键区别在于:这座枯山水自江户时代便已存在。

lines.en: : The Tsukioka family is one dating back to the origins of Kumon-mi, and this garden has been mostly untouched for all of its history.
lines.zh: : Tsukioka 家的历史可以追溯到 Kumon-mi 的起源,而这座庭园在整段历史里几乎未被改动。

lines.en: : And despite not being born into this family, I’ve taken quite a liking to it. There’s something very special about history, whether it be familial or personal.
lines.zh: : 而尽管我不是生在这一家,我却对它情有独钟。历史有种非常特别的味道——家族的也好,个人的也好。

lines.en: : And I remember the first time I ever saw this garden as if it’s the back of my hand.
lines.zh: : 我至今记得初见这座庭园的情景,清晰得如同自己的手背。

lines.en: : You wear gloves like 90%% of the time, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 你九成时间都戴着手套吧,Tsubasa。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour8
: Well...yes. But that doesn’t mean I don’t remember what my own hands look like, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是。但那不代表我不记得自己双手的模样,Sensei。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour9
: The first time I ever saw this garden was on a trip to meet my husband for the first time.
lines.zh: : 我初见这座庭园,是在第一次去见我丈夫的旅程上。

lines.en: : Arranged marriages are still very common in our world, you see. And before I was even introduced to Tomonori, I fell in love.
lines.zh: : 你看,在我们的世界里,联姻仍然非常普遍。而在我被引见给 Tomonori 之前,我已经坠入了爱河。

lines.en: : Even being from an almost equally affluent family, I’d never seen something like this in one’s own residence before.
lines.zh: : 尽管我自己家也几乎同样富有,我却从未在私人宅邸里见过这样的东西。

lines.en: : And I suppose it may make me sound a bit materialistic, but I had no intention of abandoning a place like this from the moment I laid eyes on it.
lines.zh: : 我猜这话会让我显得有点拜金,但从第一眼起,我就没打算离开这样一个地方。

lines.en: : So what you’re telling me is you married your husband for an old rock garden?
lines.zh: : 所以你要告诉我的是,你嫁给丈夫,是为了一座古老的枯山水?

lines.en: : What I’m telling you is that I married into a family I wanted to be a part of. That I wanted to continue carving out a name for. And I likely would have done that even if my husband wasn’t a good man.
lines.zh: : 我要告诉你的是,我嫁进了一个我想成为其中一员的家族。一个我想继续为之开辟名声的家族。就算我丈夫不是个好人,我多半也会这么做。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour10
: But I got lucky. He was a good man. And we made two beautiful daughters together. Daughters who will, one day, walk through this rock garden with their prospective husbands.
lines.zh: : 但我运气好。他是个好人。我们一起生了两个漂亮的女儿。她们总有一天,会和各自未来的丈夫一同走过这座枯山水。

lines.en: : Who will ultimately bring more people into our world. More people to fall in love with the history.
lines.zh: : 而她们最终会把更多人带进我们的世界。让更多人爱上这段历史。

lines.en: : What makes this particular garden so different is that it’s a physical reminder of all of that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这座庭园如此不同的地方在于,它是这一切的实体见证,Sensei。

lines.en: : It’s something I can look out on while pondering what the other women who married into the family felt about it.
lines.zh: : 我可以望着它,去想那些嫁进这个家族的其他女性,当年面对它是何感受。

lines.en: : Generations of people, all witnessing the same thing at different points in time...
lines.zh: : 一代又一代人,在不同的时间点,见证着同一件事……

lines.en: : If that doesn’t sound magical to you, I don’t know what will.
lines.zh: : 如果这在你听来都不算魔法,那我不知道什么才算。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour11
: Just kidding. I know exactly what will.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。我完全知道什么才算。

lines.en: : Now, if you’ll follow me-
lines.zh: : 现在,请随我来——

lines.en: scene black
Tsubasa leads me through the rest of the garden and over to a large building resembling a shrine.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 领着我走过庭园的其余部分,来到一座形似神社的大建筑前。

lines.en: She removes an old, rusted key from somewhere inside of her sleeve, sliding it into the door and slowly pushing it open.
lines.zh: 她从袖中某处摸出一把锈迹斑斑的旧钥匙,插进门里,缓缓推开。

lines.en: The doors creak as if they haven’t been opened in centuries, but upon stepping inside and seeing how clean and well-kept everything is, I know that can’t be true.
lines.zh: 门轴吱呀作响,仿佛几个世纪未曾开启。可一脚踏进去,看到一切干净齐整,我便知道那不可能是真的。

lines.en: And she was right.
lines.zh: 而她是对的。

lines.en: This does seem magical.
lines.zh: 这确实像有魔法。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour12
Magic isn’t real, though.
lines.zh: 但魔法并不存在。

lines.en: And I know that, behind whatever history this room holds, it’s just another room at the end of the day.
lines.zh: 而我知道,无论这房间承载着怎样的历史,归根结底,它只是又一个房间。

lines.en: It doesn’t matter who died here or who will die here- it’s an empty box filled with pretty things that exist for no real purpose.
lines.zh: 谁死在这里、谁将死在这里,都不重要——它只是一只空盒子,装满了存在却毫无真正用途的漂亮东西。

lines.en: Much like most of the world, but with a fresher coat of paint on it.
lines.zh: 和世界的大部分地方一样,只是新漆刷得更亮一些。

lines.en: It’s only magic for a moment.
lines.zh: 魔法只在一瞬之间。

lines.en: : Would you care to take a guess at what this room is?
lines.zh: : 要不要猜猜,这个房间是什么?

lines.en: : I can’t imagine anything I say would come even remotely close.
lines.zh: : 我想象不出,我说什么能沾得上边。

lines.en: : This is the Tsukioka family ceremony room. It’s where I married my husband and where my daughters will marry theirs.
lines.zh: : 这是 Tsukioka 家的仪式厅。我在这里嫁给我丈夫,我的女儿们也将在这里嫁给她们的丈夫。

lines.en: : Assuming anyone will ever take Tsukasa, that is.
lines.zh: : 前提是,真有人肯要 Tsukasa。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour13
: You all get married in here?
lines.zh: : 你们都在这里成婚?

lines.en: : As per tradition, yes. It’s the sole purpose of this room.
lines.zh: : 按传统,是的。这房间的唯一用途便是如此。

lines.en: : I’m having a very hard time picturing Touka getting married.
lines.zh: : 我非常难想象 Touka 结婚的样子。

lines.en: : I imagine that’s because you’ve only seen her as a student.
lines.zh: : 我猜,那是因为你只见过身为学生的她。

lines.en: : Touka’s been just as invested in the history of our family as me ever since she was a little girl.
lines.zh: : Touka 从小就和我一样,深深着迷于我们家族的历史。

lines.en: : She’s likely too embarrassed to say anything about it to you, but she’s been dreaming of the day she gets to stand here beside her lover for years.
lines.zh: : 她多半羞于对你提起,但多年来,她一直梦想着自己站在这里、依偎在爱人身边的那一天。

lines.en: : Yeah, still not really able to picture it.
lines.zh: : 嗯,还是想象不出来。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour14
: Has she told you that we were planning on arranging her marriage as well?
lines.zh: : 她告诉过你,我们本来也计划为她安排婚事吗?

lines.en: : We had several suitors picked out, but I could always tell she was never really comfortable with the idea.
lines.zh: : 我们挑好了好几位候选人,但我一直看得出来,她对这件事从未真正自在过。

lines.en: : They all wound up in space anyway, though, so it’s not like the plan would have come to fruition even if we hadn’t decided to...rethink things.
lines.zh: : 不过他们后来都去了太空,所以就算我们没有决定……重新考虑,那个计划也未必能成。

lines.en: : Well, I’m sure she was really happy with that decision. I can’t imagine her doing anything that’s commanded of her, let alone marrying someone.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我相信她对那个决定非常满意。我想象不出她会照吩咐做任何事,更别说嫁人了。

lines.en: : I think you’d be very surprised at what Touka would be willing to do for her family.
lines.zh: : 我想,为了家族,Touka 愿意做的事会让你大吃一惊。

lines.en: : Or anyone, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 或者说,为任何人。

lines.en: : I often think that the reason my youngest daughter is so devilish is because my oldest wound up being such an angel.
lines.zh: : 我常想,我的小女儿之所以如此小恶魔,是因为我的大女儿最终成了天使。

lines.en: : But, I suppose that basically sums up what this particular room is used for.
lines.zh: : 不过,这间房间的用途,大体就是如此了。

lines.en: : Come. I’ll show you around some of the others.
lines.zh: : 来。我再带你看看其他几间。

lines.en: : You’ll soon find that all things serve some sort of purpose.
lines.zh: : 你很快会发现,万物皆有某种用途。

lines.en: scene black
Tsubasa continues our tour of the Tsukioka manor for what feels like an eternity.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 带着我继续参观 Tsukioka 公馆,久得仿佛一个永恒。

lines.en: Every corner we round is doused in history and, I don’t know if it’s just due to spending so much time around them or if it really is an innate interest in all things Tsukioka-
lines.zh: 我们转过的每个角落都浸透了历史。我不知道,这是因为我和他们相处太久,还是我真的对所有与 Tsukioka 相关的事物有天生的兴趣——

lines.en: But she knows every single story. And she tells them as if she were there for the origins.
lines.zh: 但每一段故事她都烂熟于心。讲述时,仿佛那些故事的源头她都亲历过。

lines.en: I wonder what it’s like having so much pride in something.
lines.zh: 我不知道,对某样东西怀有如此自豪是什么感觉。

lines.en: The only pride I have is that of the sinful sort. There’s nothing that I can look at or hold and think, “This is a part of me.”
lines.zh: 我唯一的骄傲,属于罪孽的那种。没有任何东西能让我看着它、捧着它,然后想:「这是我的一部分。」

lines.en: But even if that was something I could do, I imagine I’d be more focused on just figuring out where that part belongs so I can start putting myself back together.
lines.zh: 但就算我能做到,我猜我也会更专注于弄清那一部分到底属于哪里,好让我开始把自己拼回去。

lines.en: Maybe one day when time is no longer limitless.
lines.zh: 也许某一天,当时间不再无限。

lines.en: Maybe one day when I actually want to.
lines.zh: 也许某一天,当我真的想。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour15
: We’ll cap off today’s portion of the tour with our indoor arboretum- another family relic that’s been an important part of our history for centuries.
lines.zh: : 今天的导览,将以我们的室内树木园收尾——又一件家族遗存,数百年来一直是我们历史的重要部分。

lines.en: : A long time ago, before industrialization took up its scythe and laid waste to our lands, Kumon-mi was covered in trees and filled with wildlife.
lines.zh: : 很久以前,在工业化举起镰刀、把我们的土地夷平之前,Kumon-mi 满是林木,遍布野生动物。

lines.en: : You’d never be able to tell with how things look today, but that doesn’t mean all traces of the past are gone.
lines.zh: : 以今天的光景,你绝不会相信。但这不代表过去的痕迹已荡然无存。

lines.en: : This “arboretum” holds but one tree- an everblooming sakura, kept alive by extremely specific climate controlling, imported soil, and a fair bit of willpower.
lines.zh: : 这座「树木园」只养一棵树——一棵常开不败的樱树,靠极端精确的气候控制、进口土壤,和相当一部分意志力存活。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize trees had “willpower.”
lines.zh: : 我不知道树还有「意志力」。

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t they? They’re alive, after all. Just like you and I.
lines.zh: : 为什么没有?它们毕竟是活的。和你我一样。

lines.en: : In fact, I’d wager they’re even more alive than us.
lines.zh: : 实际上,我敢说它们比我们更有活力。

lines.en: : Just think of how much this tree has seen. All of those stories I recounted for you today would be actual memories for something that’s been alive as long as our sakura.
lines.zh: : 想想这棵树见过多少。我今天给你讲的那些故事,对像我们的樱树这样长寿的生命来说,都会是真实的记忆。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour16
: I don’t want to be the bearer of bad news, but I’m pretty sure trees can’t retain memories.
lines.zh: : 我不想当报丧鸟,但我很确定,树留不住记忆。

lines.en: : Of course I know that. But if they could, imagine just how many of them there would be.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道。但假如能留,想象一下,那会是多少记忆。

lines.en: : I suppose the importance of this particular transplanted piece of nature isn’t in what it could hold, however, and rather what it stands for.
lines.zh: : 不过我想,这件被移栽的自然之物的意义,不在它能承载什么,而在它象征着什么。

lines.en: : Which is?
lines.zh: : 象征什么?

lines.en: : Perseverance.
lines.zh: : 坚忍。

lines.en: : To be the only remaining trace of what was once an important part of the world...I believe there is something special about that.
lines.zh: : 作为曾经是世界重要一环的事物仅存的痕迹……我相信其中有种特别的东西。

lines.en: : Every other aspect of this tree’s world has been, and forgive the pun, cut down.
lines.zh: : 这棵树世界里的一切其他部分,都——请原谅这个双关——被「砍」掉了。

lines.en: : All that remains is the ground itself, and even that ground would not suffice in keeping it alive anymore.
lines.zh: : 剩下的只有土地本身,而连那片土地,也已不足以让它存活。

lines.en: : In here, though...
lines.zh: : 可是在这里……

lines.en: : In this world created for the sole purpose of sustaining it...
lines.zh: : 在这个为供养它而专门创造的世界里……

lines.en: : It can live.
lines.zh: : 它能活。

lines.en: : And I think that’s beautiful.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得,那很美。

lines.en: : Has my explanation floored you to the point of speechlessness?
lines.zh: : 我的解说是否让你震撼到无话可说?

lines.en: : Not particularly.
lines.zh: : 谈不上。

lines.en: : I just think it’s interesting how you can speak so highly of things other people would see as boring or unimportant at surface level.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得有意思:别人表面上看会觉得无聊或不重要的东西,你却能说得如此崇高。

lines.en: : As I said earlier, this is my world. It’s one that I chose and one that I would choose if the chance to do so repeated itself.
lines.zh: : 正如我先前所说,这是我的世界。是我选的世界。若选择的机会再现,我依然会这么选。

lines.en: : Of course I’ll be able to find the right berries to pick when I know where all of them grow.
lines.zh: : 既然我知道所有浆果长在哪里,当然能挑对要采的那几颗。

lines.en: : If that’s a figure of speech, I’m not really following.
lines.zh: : 如果这是比喻,我没跟上。

lines.en: : I’m saying that I know why everything here is so special because I have had the time to learn.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是,我知道这里的一切为何如此特别,因为我有时间去学。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’s not far off from how your family feels about...arcade machines or...what were those silly things we ate called again? Toucans?
lines.zh: : 我确信,这和你们家对……街机、或者……我们吃的那些傻玩意叫什么来着?大嘴鸟?……的感受相去不远。

lines.en: : Tacos...and those aren’t really a thing that carry some sort of emotional weight for people who don’t grow up with arboretums or marriage-rooms.
lines.zh: : 是塔可……而且对不是伴着树木园和婚仪厅长大的人来说,塔可并不承载什么情感重量。

lines.en: : Well, whatever it is you find special, then.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那就换成你眼中特别的东西。

lines.en: : I believe that there is beauty in all things. And even if you do not, that’s something I wanted to show you.
lines.zh: : 我相信万物皆美。就算你不信,这也是我想给你看的东西。

lines.en: : As a friend who wants to be a part of your world and who wants to share hers with you.
lines.zh: : 以一个朋友的名义——一个想走进你的世界、也想与你分享她的世界的朋友。

lines.en: scene tsubasatour17
: I suppose there is one more place we can stop before our day comes to a close, though. Something I’m sure all people can appreciate and not just those with an affinity for history.
lines.zh: : 不过,在今天结束之前,我想还有一站可以去。我确信那是所有人都能欣赏的东西,而不只是偏爱历史的人。

lines.en: : Am I finally getting to see the animatronic band I’ve heard so much about?
lines.zh: : 我终于能见到那个如雷贯耳的机器人乐队了?

lines.en: : Heavens, no. That’s at one of our vacation homes.
lines.zh: : 天哪,不。那个在我们的一栋度假屋里。

lines.en: : You’ll see what I’m referring to in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 很快你就会明白我指的是什么。

lines.zh: Tsubasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsubasa_love]!
